title: Two years of the Travis County childcare tax
subtitle: Where the money voters approved in 2024 has gone, and what providers still report
alt: Timeline of the Travis County childcare tax: voters approved a property tax increase in November 2024 raising about $75 million a year; a 2025 United Way for Greater Austin survey found turnover above 40 percent, with 418 early childhood teachers leaving in a year; by July 2026 about 150 providers were receiving monthly gap payments totaling $4.2 million; and by August 2026 more than $51 million had been allocated, covering 7,500 children in after-school and summer programs and 1,000 new scholarships
